Arrived at the response location; the group of vagrants had already moved along. Quick standby to show presence before moving along.
Continuing patrols due to no concerns identified.

Arrived at the corner intersection between Albert and Victoria Street; welfare checks on all stores, all clear.
Checked in at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street; checked in on static guards, all clear.
Arrived at HQ; due to Ops Phone battery running low, commencing standby while awaiting further response calls.
No issues during standby; continuing standby while taking lunch break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Response call from Cotton On reporting two females refusing to hand over a purple bikini they did not purchase.

Stopped the POIs and asked for the stolen items back; they refused and tried to lie, but we caught them shoving the items inside their shirts under their arms. After confronting them they complied and handed the items back. A verbal trespass was issued to the thief (posted to Auror). Advised Cotton On to file a report to police.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Debrief with morning shift before gearing up and commencing patrols.
Debrief with morning shift; gearing up and commencing Alpha Route patrols.
Response call from Cotton On regarding a male individual shoplifting with a lot of products in their possession; en route to location.

Arrived at response location; male individual was not in store, but staff said he was approaching the red City Link bus. Quickly stopped the bus but the individual was nowhere to be found. Patrolling the area to spot the individual with stolen goods.
Patrolled the area but could not find the individual described; heading back to Cotton On to retrieve footage or photo evidence.
Standing down from Cotton On; continuing patrols down Queen Street.

Response call from Harbour Suites regarding a female individual who was refused from their site and is currently outside shouting, screaming and making other guests feel uncomfortable; en route to location.
Response call from Sunglasses Bar regarding a male adult who recently stole from their store and tried entering again but was denied; notified the adult walked down High Street; en route to location.
Patrolled bottom of High Street, Fort Lane and Shortland; adult was not seen in the area. Heading back to Sunglasses Bar to retrieve footage.
Footage received; standing down from response location, making our way down to Harbour Suites.
Arrived at Harbour Suites; female adult had already left the premises. Retrieving footage from premises.

Police arrived at our location and are arresting the male individual; standing by for any police assistance.
